[contact omitted] Peter Natiello Thursday, December 8, 2022 at 11:30:59 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Marcela Escobari, [contact omitted] Alexander Brockwehl

simply sharing info, that luis is connected with vera, on the mis-dis info META work...
--- Forwarded message-----
From: Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]>
Date: Thu, Dec 8, 2022 at 10:01 AM
Subject: Re: From the WWU
To: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Daniella Burgi-Palomino <[contact omitted]>, Peter Natiello <[contact omitted]>
Just added you to the invite.
Luis
On Tat is Pabuli, us zouali. 1d lov to gzinkem avakam. ksaid goea wohat kind of collaboration they propose as well.
Just an fyi. Meta has accepted a number of organizations from Moldova into its trusted partner program separate to fact
checkina so worth explorina that. I don't think thev do it for most countries. We should develop a criteria across the
globe of countries we might want to propose,of course including LAC,
On Thu, Dec 8, 2022 at 9:24 AM Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hello Vera,
Daniella Burgi-Pallomino and I (both from LAC/RSD) will meet with Meta. We currently have Mission tech POCs
throughout LAC. The main issues to raise is to create streamlined procedures for those POCs to flag
inappropriate content to Meta (similar to what we did in the Guatemala case). We also plan to offer CSOs to serve as
fact checkers (or at least have direct "white glove service" access to Meta). Meta also proposed some areas of joint
collaboration which we will discuss as well.
Having saidthat, we're happy to raise any other issues or add anyone else to the meeting.
Luis
On Wed, Dec 7, 2022 at 8:50 PM Peter Natiello <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Vera. Luis and I will reach out in the coming days to deepen the Metabconversation. Best, Peter.
Sent from my iPhone
On Dec 7, 2022, at 11:13 AM, Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Peter!
Would love to connect with you guys on this! And great work by Luis and the team.

Subject: Re: From the WWU

thanks for flagging - do we know who at USAID will meet with Meta?
On Wed, Dec 7, 2022 at 10:34 AM Leah Werchick <[contact omitted]> wrote:
ICYMI...
USAID collaborates with Meta to remove harmful content against Guatemalan judge. Last
week, LAC and the NTTF reached out to Meta to raise awareness on the Fundacion contra el
Terrorismo's (FCT) threatening posts against Guatemalan Judge Yassmin Barrios, a 2014
International Women of Courage awardee. This has been a common practice from FCT, as similar
content contributed to high-level judges and prosecutors going into exile. Meta escalated this
request and determined that, while FCT's Facebook page as a whole doesn't violate its standards,
one of the posts was confirmed as violating its "Violence & Incitement" policies and was removed.
While USAID believes FCT's behavior is recurrent and could lead to further restrictions, the
removal of this post is a step in the right direction. USAID will meet with Meta in mid-December to
create direct communications channels between Missions and Meta to flag
similar content and take down threatening posts or accounts in a speedy manner.
Leah Werchick
Senior Policy Advisor
Atrocity Prevention/Countering Violent Extremism
USAID Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization
